methodology.rule: Only information public at or before cutoff may be used for the simulated decision. Outcome is revealed only after decision is frozen.
methodology.purpose: Training examples for catalyst persistence, continuation, chase avoidance, and dilution filters. Not a claim of predictive accuracy.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Persist a high-quality primary catalyst for several sessions even if immediate price confirmation is weak; rescan for later validation plus volume.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Certification can be an underabsorbed catalyst; do not require a same-minute price spike.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Material upgrade/target change can produce multi-day continuation; retain on watchlist after day one.

cases.label: event_driven_late_risk
cases.lesson: A post-close M&A report may already reprice after-hours; alert quickly but distinguish discovery after publication from prediction before publication.

cases.label: gap_hold_only
cases.lesson: Strong earnings can be valid while a large premarket gap makes a fresh entry late; require gap-and-hold confirmation.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Do not expire analyst catalysts after one session; continuation and pullback/reclaim patterns matter.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: New shares/pre-funded warrants/public offerings require dilution penalty and should not score as bullish merely because catalyst keywords are strong.

cases.label: late_chase_avoid
cases.lesson: After an extraordinary one-session repricing, default to late/chase risk unless a new independent catalyst appears.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Large offering plus warrants is a dilution/overhang pattern; high RVOL confirms repricing but does not make it bullish.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Unit offerings with warrants should receive strong negative direction classification.

cases.label: analyst_validation
cases.lesson: Upgrade plus a large target increase deserves positive analyst-action scoring; generic 'price target' noise penalty must not suppress it.

cases.label: late_binary_risk
cases.lesson: Constructive FDA briefing documents can reprice shares before the panel; after a large move classify as binary/late rather than early.

cases.label: binary_positive_reprice
cases.lesson: FDA hold removal is directional and material; alert immediately, but after a large gap/reprice do not call it early.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Regulatory update language can conceal a materially negative FDA requirement; semantic direction must override generic FDA keyword scores.

cases.label: bearish_reaction
cases.lesson: Headline beats are insufficient when guidance/margins or expectations disappoint; negative tape reaction is material evidence.

cases.label: weak_false_positive
cases.lesson: Double beat can still sell off; require expectation/guidance context and price acceptance.

cases.label: no_trade
cases.lesson: A beat with only muted reaction should not be promoted merely by headline numbers.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Weight insider buying by role, dollar value, stake change and proximity to lows; open-market CFO purchase near $1M is stronger than routine small buys.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Large repeated chairman open-market purchases can be a meaningful signal, but price/volume confirmation remains required.

cases.label: reacting_watch
cases.lesson: Strategic defense/Space Force orders deserve high catalyst quality; if already on a multi-day run, downgrade for chase risk.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Upgrade plus major target reset plus sector narrative can be underabsorbed when day-one move is modest.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Double upgrade plus 100% target reset and upcoming regulatory cluster is stronger than a standalone target note.

cases.label: binary_late_risk
cases.lesson: Constructive FDA briefing documents are highly material, but a 30%+ immediate reprice converts the state to binary/late.

cases.label: reacting_watch
cases.lesson: Approval before PDUFA with broad label is strong; distinguish unexpected timing/label surprise from already-priced approval.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: FDA approval plus monetizable priority-review vouchers can improve balance sheet even after prior trial failure; evaluate net catalyst stack.

cases.label: late_arbitrage
cases.lesson: Definitive acquisition is high certainty but a ~95% opening gap leaves little momentum edge; classify as late/arb.

cases.label: high_momentum_event
cases.lesson: Modest opening gap plus extreme RVOL and strong close location after a fresh partnership is a price-volume acceleration family.

cases.label: late_chase_risk
cases.lesson: Fresh partnership can reprice microcaps violently; a 40%+ opening gap requires chase-risk controls.

cases.label: gap_hold
cases.lesson: Large earnings gap can remain strong when volume is extraordinary and price holds near session highs; gap size alone is not sufficient to reject.

cases.label: extreme_momentum
cases.lesson: Small opening gap followed by extreme intraday repricing is detectable by acceleration/RVOL, but risk controls must react as move becomes parabolic.

cases.label: late_arbitrage
cases.lesson: Take-private definitive agreement often gaps directly near consideration value; alert event but do not treat as early upside setup.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Negative trial readout is directional and should dominate generic clinical-trial catalyst points.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Weak post-earnings price acceptance near session low is bearish evidence even when headline parsing is ambiguous.

cases.label: weak_false_positive
cases.lesson: Large headline contract/purchase-order claims that the tape rejects require credibility and economics checks rather than automatic bullish scoring.

cases.label: weak_false_positive
cases.lesson: Huge reported growth can still be rejected; quality, expectations and financing context matter.

cases.label: dilution_risk
cases.lesson: Proposed common/pre-funded-warrant offering is financing overhang until terms and market absorption are known.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Registered direct plus large pre-funded warrant component should trigger dilution direction classifier.

cases.label: dilution_risk
cases.lesson: Pre-funded and common warrants create dilution/overhang even when sold to an existing institutional investor.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Registered direct common stock plus pre-funded warrants is directional dilution/overhang; extreme volume on the selloff confirms repricing, not bullish momentum.

cases.label: event_reprice
cases.lesson: Prior management hints about an unnamed hyperscaler can justify watch status, but the counterparty identity and deal magnitude cannot be backfilled before the public announcement.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Consensus estimate revisions plus rank/momentum lists are secondary evidence; require independent price-volume confirmation and a primary catalyst where possible.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Large upward earnings-estimate revision can seed a watchlist but is not sufficient alone for high conviction.

cases.label: no_trade_without_confirmation
cases.lesson: Rank upgrades and estimate revisions in liquid large caps should receive lower urgency unless accompanied by a fresh material catalyst or abnormal tape.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: A fresh Neutral-to-Buy upgrade is a valid analyst-action event; magnitude of target reset and tape response determine urgency.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Initiation at Overweight is weaker than an upgrade after new information unless target implication and market reaction are unusually large.

cases.label: strong_dilution_risk
cases.lesson: Unit offering containing one share plus multiple warrants is an especially severe dilution structure and should trigger strong negative direction classification.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Large strategic AI partnership can be material even with modest initial move; assess economics, duration and incremental revenue rather than narrative alone.

cases.label: reacting_watch
cases.lesson: Favorable analyst action can trigger meaningful same-day movement; after a material move downgrade early status and look for continuation structure.

cases.label: reacting_watch
cases.lesson: Product collaboration plus immediate 7%+ repricing is material but no longer pristine early entry; retain only for continuation confirmation.

cases.label: fundamental_reprice
cases.lesson: New financial targets plus buyback form a stacked fundamental catalyst; measure whether guidance delta versus expectations justifies the gap.

learned_rules: Persist high-quality catalysts for 3-5 trading sessions and rescore when price/volume confirmation arrives.
Penalize common-stock offerings, pre-funded warrants, ATM/S-3/424B5 overhang and convertibles unless context clearly offsets dilution.
Create a dedicated analyst-action family: upgrade/initiation plus unusually large target revision.
Treat large premarket gaps and extreme one-day moves as chase-risk states, not automatically high-conviction entries.
Use market reaction as confirmation, not as a requirement that deletes an otherwise valid underabsorbed catalyst.

summary.note: Reached 50 mixed point-in-time training cases spanning positive, negative, late/chase, dilution, analyst, regulatory, earnings and no-trade controls.
